title: Sphere batch support without margin
summary: Recovered 0x47d560 (54 bytes): thiscall member with directions, outputs and signed count; clears all four lanes of each 16-byte output for positive counts. Directions and sphere state are unused. Vtable slot +0x40 and virtual callers 0x47ba46/0x47bfe6/0x47ce9e establish argument roles; no output is touched for nonpositive counts.
test_description: Direct original comparison for INT_MIN, negative, zero, 1, 2, 6, 17 and 257 counts; separate, null, identical and shifted overlapping directions; 10 direction bit patterns including signaling NaNs, infinities and subnormals under four rounding modes. Check every output byte, guards and unused trailing vectors, unchanged opaque object/directions, MXCSR and installed FS head. Null outputs are tested for nonpositive counts.
known_limits: Sphere layout and unrelated methods are intentionally opaque; this operation reads no fields.
Positive counts require valid writable Vector4 arrays. Faulting pointers, inaccessible storage and non-C++ object lifetimes are not modeled; the original uses unchecked dword stores.
Very large positive counts are not executed due to storage limits; their loop rule is directly evident in the original instructions.
No matching machine-code or full physics integration claim.
